scope: C08 reference: HUD, state communication and operation guidance
method: The reference was evaluated specifically for screen information and guidance. A visually impaired player's specialist launch review, a later Director's Cut accessibility review, a UI design analysis and later player discussion were separated. Positive evidence and accessibility failures were both retained.

positiveBasis: Specialist accessibility criticism identifies large high-contrast menus, large icons and visible item feedback as strong components.
A UI analysis documents contextual HUD visibility, in-world wind/animal/smoke guidance, pickup glints and damage-state feedback as a coherent information design.
The later Director's Cut improved text size, wind visibility, combat cue visibility and tracking assistance.
Player discussion three years after launch still specifically supports the minimal HUD and wind guidance.
counterevidence: Launch objectives and health at screen edges were hard to read at a glance, and some emphasis colors had poor contrast.
Director's Cut button prompts lost color associations, footprint tracking remained hard to see and lock-on required repeated input.
Players report that the HUD cannot be completely disabled and that guiding birds fail around obstacles; some prefer conventional waypoints.
remaining: Acquire actual matched UI and operation-flow material and perform a valid source-blind comparison.
Complete the remaining incomplete four-axis selections for other elements.

formalVerdictReason: No candidate/reference source-blind comparison was performed. Reference-selection research cannot assign a game-element verdict.

verification.result: PASS: 10 units, 16 legacy groups, 62 legacy criteria, six negative checks, fixed instruction text unchanged
